reason: Both reach the same correct core: activated users are roughly flat, the bonus attracted low-intent and fraudulent signups, and the reward should be paid on activation. A adds referrer revocation and an immediate pause. B adds a KPI change to cost per activated user, a two-sided reward, a kill criterion based on whether activated users rise above the pre-bonus level, and a clear diagnostic for the case where organic activation also fell. B covers the net-activated-users point better and is more decision-oriented. A covers referrer segmentation slightly better.
